epistemic_boundary.canonical: Ars Caeli repository Markdown/JSON documents are the documentary source.
epistemic_boundary.experimental: Translations into UI, audio, metrics, and visualization are operational and experimental.
epistemic_boundary.symbolic: Frequency correspondences are internal/symbolic to the system and must not be presented as medical facts.
epistemic_boundary.atlas: ATLAS records observations, parameters, and interpretations; it does not determine causality.

phase_machine.shadow_and_light: Derived mechanically as midpoints from the retained descenso, sesion, and retorno control points.

signal_layers.symbolic_carrier_hz: Selected symbolic target; Oscillator A equals this value.
signal_layers.harmonic_b_hz: Triangle Oscillator B equals 2 x carrier.
signal_layers.modulation_hz: S.field.pulse controls the amplitude LFO independently.
signal_layers.environmental_breath_hz: S.field.breath controls a slow envelope with <=4% depth.
signal_layers.measurement_boundary: AnalyserNode describes generated browser signal, not acoustic calibration or physiology.

construct_operational_mappings.definition: Source ACSPEC construct; operational mapping is an experimental AEON implementation.

presence.audio: harmonic B density and supporting stereo occupancy

visualization_contract.waves: AnalyserNode time-domain data while running; explicit idle baseline otherwise.
visualization_contract.spectrum: AnalyserNode frequency-domain data with carrier and harmonic markers.
visualization_contract.axis: Current Underworld, Activation, Dissociation, and Opening values; no body claims.
visualization_contract.torus: Coupled to current presence, resonance, horizon, entropy, crystallization, breath, and pulse.

observation_contract.microvoid: User-registered operational event, not physiological measurement.
observation_contract.phase_transitions: Stored separately from microvoids with automatic/manual source.
observation_contract.causality: The UI does not infer that a generated signal caused a reported sensation.
